name: Pro
summary: Two backs and receivers spread wide. Makes them defend the whole field instead of stacking the middle.
personnel: 11 players, split end, tight end, flanker, quarterback, halfback, fullback
notes: Two backs split behind the quarterback, a tight end to the right, a split end wide left and a flanker outside the tight end. This is the formation that makes a defense cover the whole field instead of stacking the middle. Seven on the line: the split end, five interior linemen and the tight end.
coaching_notes: The split end and the flanker may never block anybody all game. That is fine — they are out there to make two defenders leave the box.
Both backs are the same depth, so neither one tips the play. Do not let them cheat forward on their running plays.
Count seven on the line every snap. The flanker must be off it and the split end must be on it.
